reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing precondition pattern (assertBankAccountNotLinked) with a sibling assertion helper and uses db.first like its neighbours.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the one-line call is repeated in each of the six provider link functions, mirroring the existing assertion call next to it.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside assertBankAccountNotLinked and runs before any bank creation, update or sync.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Clear and easy to own; a new provider must remember to call both assertions, which a shared link-precondition step would have avoided.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link* functions call the new assertUpgradingAccountOpen alongside the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the closed check lives only in assertUpgradingAccountOpen.

one_place.where: assertUpgradingAccountOpen in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount, linkFintegraAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
